spans.s: ल (1) consonant ल्; see ल् above' (2) a general term usually used by ancient grammarians to signify- लोप (elision or disappearance) of a letter or a syllable or a word; cf. सर्वसादेर्द्विगोश्र्च ल: | सवार्तिक:, द्वितन्त्र: M. Bh. on
; (3) tad. affix ल added to the word क्लिन्न when चिल् and पिल् are substituted for the word क्लिन्न; e.g, चिल्लः, पिल्ल: cf.
